title: Momentum roots instead of slogans
promptMarkdown: Use v_{t+1}=βv_t+λz_t and z_{t+1}=z_t−ηv_{t+1}, with β=.81, η=.01 andλ=10. Derive the second-order recurrence, calculate its characteristic roots or their modulus, and decide asymptotic stability. Repeat forη=.40. With z₀=1, v₀=0, compute z₁, z₂ for the first setting. Explain why a complex root does not by itself mean divergence.
hintLadder: The product of characteristic roots is β.
Track the declared velocity convention in the first two updates.
